title: Design register (parsed from spec/designs.csv)
description: One row per DESIGN, not per estimator. Estimator choice never moves a design up a tier — two-way fixed effects, Callaway-Sant'Anna and Sun-Abraham are estimator options of the one DiD design, not three designs.

allOf.$comment: A counterfactual design must sit on a rung.
The theory-based strand runs beside the ladder and is never converted into a rung, so a tier on a theory-based row is an error rather than an omission.

strand.description: Whether the design identifies an effect by comparison with a counterfactual, or belongs to the parallel theory-based strand.

tier.description: Required for counterfactual designs; forbidden for theory-based ones.

estimator_options.description: Pipe-separated in the CSV, parsed to an array. Estimator choice never moves a design up a tier.

tier_qualifier.description: Where a design sits at an edge of its tier, e.g. matching with prior-outcome controls as upper Tier 4.
